claim_boundary: Finite-dimensional linear algebra over exact rationals. Theorem C characterises when a real linear flow IS a Schrodinger flow; Theorem D shows a single real channel never is. Neither asserts that the paper's energy dynamics does or does not admit such a structure — that is D2a/D2b, which remain OPEN.

reduces_obligation.D2: not discharged; reduced to D2a + D2b
reduces_obligation.D2a: name the conjugate channel of dE and exhibit the complex structure J on the pair
reduces_obligation.D2b: show the linearised generator on that pair is antisymmetric (no symmetric/damping part)

theorem_D_one_channel_obstruction.consequence: The scalar linearisation of the null-coordinate energy dynamics carries no complex structure, hence cannot be Schrodinger evolution; a declared conjugate channel is required (obligations D2a, D2b).
